character_dna.name: Alex
character_dna.description: A 28-year-old intrepid space explorer wearing a retro-futuristic bronze and leather expedition suit with a glowing holographic compass on his wrist and magnetic adventure boots.
character_dna.acting: Confident, athletic, and resourceful. Moves with deliberate tactical speed, scanning alien structures, deciphering holographic glyphs, and vaulting across obstacles.

world_rules.setting: Ruinas alienígenas bioluminiscentes, templos de cristal bajo auroras boreales cósmicas y cañones de arena dorada en exoplanetas.
world_rules.tone: Misión trepidante de 30 segundos, suspenso de exploración sci-fi a contrarreloj y alta adrenalina cinematográfica.

visual_style: High-end cinematic sci-fi live-action, 35mm anamorphic lens, atmospheric mist, volumetric golden rim light, creamy bokeh, ultra-detailed textures.
